entities.name: Manjali Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Manjali Mosque is located on Satpayev Avenue in the center of Atyrau, Kazakhstan. Construction began in 1999 and was completed in 2001. The mosque opened for public use on 5 May 2001 and can accommodate 600 worshipers.
